assembly_notes: Wooden drop-leaf folding dining table. One rigid table_center root carries the tabletop centre strip, its apron and every centre-side bracket. Two drop_leaf parts are REVOLUTE children of the centre on an alternating butt hinge whose axis sits HINGE_DROP under the tabletop plane; q=0 is deployed and coplanar, q=pi/2 is folded straight down. top_profile only changes the plan outline the centre strip and both leaves are cut from (circle, ellipse, racetrack, or rectangular spine plus half-round D leaves); the seam, hinge line and apron rectangle are identical across all four. support_system is one structural family of collapsible leg systems: corner_fold_legs and center_pedestal hinge off the centre, while the four trestle candidates hinge off a leaf underside and MIMIC that leaf so a stored trestle folds flat along its leaf instead of sweeping under the table. leaf_stay is an independent per-leaf folding bracket carried on the leaf itself: prop_arm swings on a pivot across the leaf, scissor_link unfolds a crossed link pair, and slide_rail runs out on a real PRISMATIC guide. Every stay reaches toward the seam but stops STAY_INBOARD outboard of it, so nothing a leaf carries can swing in over the centre at any leaf angle. stay_per_leaf multiplies the stay units on each leaf, always symmetric, so the model carries 2 * stay_per_leaf stay parts; stations are pitched along the seam, clamped to the leaf's real half-width at that station and kept clear of the trestle station. The corner legs sit below the apron and clear of the band a folded leaf's stays occupy. top_length_m, top_width_m, center_width_ratio and table_height_m are the independent parameters; palette and decorative fastener counts are non-core.

multiplicities.host_capacity_expression: 1 <= stay_per_leaf <= 3; stay pitch >= stay width + 40 mm across top_length_m, and stay stations stay clear of the support frame stations
multiplicities.name: stay_per_leaf
multiplicities.spacing_expression: stay units are pitched evenly along the hinge line on each leaf, mirrored on both leaves

candidates.evidence: Circular plan: centre strip clipped out of a full circle, leaves are the two remaining circular segments.
candidates.name: round_arc

parameters.name: top_length_m
parameters.rationale: tabletop extent along the hinge line; derives leaf length, frame span, stay pitch and apron length

parameters.name: top_width_m
parameters.rationale: deployed tabletop extent across the leaves; derives leaf reach, stay reach and support footprint

parameters.name: center_width_ratio
parameters.rationale: fixed centre strip width as a fraction of top_width_m; derives hinge_x, apron width and leaf reach

parameters.name: table_height_m
parameters.rationale: deployed top surface height; derives leg drop, pivot heights and stay heights

parameters.name: hinge_x_m
parameters.rationale: hinge seam offset from the table centre line

parameters.name: leaf_reach_m
parameters.rationale: horizontal reach of one drop leaf from its hinge

parameters.name: leg_drop_m
parameters.rationale: vertical drop from a support pivot down to the floor pad

parameters.name: stay_reach_m
parameters.rationale: how far a deployed leaf stay reaches out under the leaf underside
